acs.criterion: `eh run` computes cost from its own cumulative normalized usage x the resolved model's gateway rates — honoring `--gateway-provider` pins (per-endpoint pricing, not model-aggregate) and tiered prompt/completion rates — and emits it on the final `cumulative: true` `usage` event and/or `run.completed` as `costUsd` with `costSource: "gateway-rates"`.
acs.evidence: src/headless-run.ts emitCostSummary() emits a final cumulative:true usage event with costUsd+costSource from headlessCost(rateCard, accumulatedUsage); rateCard resolved by fetchHeadlessRateCard (per-endpoint pricing when pinned, tier brackets via endpointRates). src/pricing.test.ts 'fetchHeadlessRateCard resolves per-endpoint pricing for a gateway pin' proves the nebius pin bills per-endpoint ($5.8) not aggregate ($5.0); src/headless-run.test.ts 'emits a gateway-rate costUsd on the final usage event for a pinned run' asserts an end-to-end run yields costSource:'gateway-rates' with costUsd≈0.000034.

acs.criterion: A harness-reported cost, when present, is preserved in a separate field (e.g. `harnessCostUsd`), never silently preferred over the computed one.
acs.evidence: Per-event usage now emits harnessCostUsd (renamed from costUsd) in src/headless-run.ts; the summary event carries harnessCostUsd separately from the computed costUsd. src/headless-run.test.ts claude-on-ollama asserts harnessCostUsd:0.25 alongside computed costUsd:0, and the gateway-rate test asserts harnessCostUsd:0.25 alongside costUsd≈0.000034 — harness cost is preserved, never promoted.

acs.criterion: When rates are unavailable (ollama, unknown model), no fabricated cost is emitted and `costSource` says why.
acs.evidence: headlessCost returns costUsd:undefined for kind 'unavailable'; emitCostSummary omits costUsd when undefined. fetchHeadlessRateCard→'free' for ollama and 'unavailable' for unknown models (src/pricing.test.ts). Real CLI run on ollama emits: {"costSource":"free","costUsd":0,...,"v":2}. src/pricing.test.ts 'headlessCost classifies the source and never fabricates cost' covers free/unavailable/gateway-rates.

acs.criterion: Cache read/write tokens are billed at the endpoint's published cache rates; when an endpoint publishes no cache rates, the chosen behavior (bill as regular input vs zero) is explicit and documented in the code.
acs.evidence: endpointRates reads cache fields (cachedInputTokens/input_cache_read, cacheCreationInputTokens/input_cache_write); gatewayCostUsd falls back to the input rate for missing cache rates with a documented comment in src/pricing.ts (a no-discount provider bills cache as ordinary input; zero would understate). src/pricing.test.ts 'gatewayCostUsd bills cache tokens at the input rate when unpublished' asserts $0.14 (input-rate fallback) vs $0.014 (published cache rate).

acs.criterion: If the event shape changes, the NDJSON event `v` field is bumped per eh's versioned-stream convention.
acs.evidence: PROTOCOL_VERSION bumped 1→2 in src/headless-run.ts; every emitted NDJSON object carries v:2 (confirmed by the real CLI run output and by every assertion across src/headless-run.test.ts, all updated to v:2).
